transcript.content: hey, i'm berry. tell me about your dream, however it comes back to you.
it’s mostly the glass that stuck with me. i kept trying to see through it but everything outside was made of it too
that’s strange, like the thing you were trying to see past was everywhere, even in whatever was beyond it
yeah exactly. it wasn’t really an outside. the window wasn’t a way out, it was just the whole world
so you weren’t trying to escape through it, more like you were already inside it. what did you do next?
don't remember much after that. just that i’d gotten to my parents' house and was waiting for something, and then i was in that glassy blur
your parents’ house, that’s interesting. was it like the real one, or did it feel different from usual?
i don’t remember seeing much of the house itself. everything around it had that hazy glow, trees and stuff all blurry like light coming through
so even the familiar place got lost in that glow. sounds like you weren’t even sure how close you were to it
yeah, it felt close but not clear. like i was right there and still couldn’t really make it out
that’s a weird feeling, being somewhere you know but can’t quite get into focus. what was the feeling like, inside that?
kind of calm but stuck. not scared. just waiting and everything soft and bright but you can’t touch it right
calm but stuck, that’s a strange combo. like nothing was wrong, but nothing would quite resolve either
yeah. exactly that. it was bright and quiet and nothing would end
nothing would end. was there anyone else in all that brightness, or were you on your own there?
i don’t remember anyone else. just me, i think
just you in all that light. when you were there, was it like you were in your own body, or more like you were watching yourself from somewhere else?
i think i was in my own body. i remember stepping into the window like i was going to walk through it
stepping into it, like it wasn’t solid. did you make it through, or is that where it all goes blurry?
that’s where the dream shifted. i didn’t pass through, i just ended up inside that glassy place
ah, so the step became a shift, not a crossing. like you never got to the other side because the other side was just more of it
right. the other side was the same thing, just more window. there wasn’t a break in it
that must’ve been disorienting, even though you said it was calm. like looking for an edge that isn’t there
it was. i wandered a bit but it all stayed translucent and blurry. the rocks and grass were glowing through the haze
so there was a landscape there, just smeared with that same glow. could you hear anything in that place, or was it quiet too?
i don’t remember any sound. just that heavy quiet like glass might make if it could hold silence
that’s a lovely way to put it, silence the way glass holds it. seems like the quiet was part of the substance, not just an absence of sound
yeah, it felt thick like that. not empty quiet, more like something in the air you could almost see
almost visible quiet. that fits the whole dream, things that should be clear but stay just out of reach
yes, everything was like that. familiar shapes but you couldn’t get them clear
was there one shape or thing you kept noticing, even through the blur?
trees mostly. and the rocks. they were glowing, which made them stand out even though they weren’t clear
so it wasn’t all one flat glow, there were these brighter pieces. did the rocks and trees feel like they meant anything, or were they just the surroundings?
i think just surroundings. but there was something about them being lit from inside, not from the sky or anything
lit from the inside, that’s different to a normal light. did that feel magical, or more like the whole world was just that way?
more like the whole world was just that way. not magical, just the way it was

so you were trying to see through glass, but everything beyond it was glass too, no outside at all, and you stepped into it like walking through a window. you ended up near your parents' house, but the whole world was hazy and bright, trees and rocks glowing from inside, everything calm but stuck. you were alone, wandering a quiet that felt thick like glass holding silence, and nothing would end.
yes, that’s it. nothing missing from that
then could i try drawing it for you, as it felt to you? maybe one picture of that glowing, waiting place, if you'd like
i’d like that. yes, please

i could draw it like a pale glass photograph, crisp but glowing from the inside out. or soft pastel on paper, gentle smudges bright and blurred. or a translucent digital painting, everything glowing faintly through an invisible pane. or a bright, blurry photograph, real life softened and lit from within.

which of those feels closest to your dream? or if you'd describe your own way, i'd love to hear it.
the soft pastel one, i think. blurred and bright at the same time

soft pastel it is. i'll start with that glassy blur.

i picture it as an indistinct space, not quite a place, just blurred shapes like trees and rocks made of translucent glassy substance. the light is bright and hazy, glowing from inside the objects themselves. i filled in some guesses: glowing trees and rocks, and maybe hazy outlines of a window or window-like surfaces. does that sound right, or would you rather i change anything?
that sounds right. especially the glowing from inside the objects

i'm sketching the glassy blur and the window and the parents' house surroundings now, it'll appear on the right. nothing else is being drawn yet.

and i'll draw you too, since you're in it. would you like to be drawn as you are? you can tell me a little about yourself, or i can imagine you however feels right.
i’d rather you imagine me, just however feels right

then i'll imagine you, just however feels right.

i'm sketching you now. everything will come together on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks off once it's there, just say.
it looks right. the glow is how i remember it
so the glassy blur, the window, the parents' house surroundings, and you there too, does it all look the way you remember it?
mostly. the house isn’t quite how i remember, but the dream didn’t give me a clear view of it anyway. the rest fits though

the house can stay a little unclear then, since that's how the dream kept it.

i'll draw the moments of the dream in order now, each one carrying on from the ones before it. they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
okay. that first one feels right, with the window in front of me and all the glass beyond it
good. i'll draw the rest of the dream from there, the moments that carried on from that window. they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
alright, i’ll wait. the glow in that first one is how it felt, already caught in it

caught in it, that's exactly how it felt.

the other moments are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right soon.
this second one’s closer to the waiting part. the blur feels more like the world there
does that second one look the way you remember it?
yes, it does. it’s still calm there, not scary. the light’s the same
good, that's the waiting feeling caught. i'll draw the next moments, they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
the third one’s right too. the landscape looks like i’m in it, not just looking at it

that one fits too.

i'll draw the last two moments now, they'll appear on the right.
